outlook.statement: The Company remains focused on identifying and securing differentiated opportunities arising from favourable industry tailwinds. Experience in executing specialised media projects, combined with technology-driven approach, positions the company well to participate in emerging opportunities where entry barriers, innovation and execution capabilities create long-term competitive advantages.

Focus remains unwavering: strengthening technological capabilities, expanding media infrastructure footprint, pursuing strategic growth opportunities and creating enduring value for shareholders and stakeholders.

The rebranding of radio network from TOP FM to LFM is expected to enhance listener engagement, improve brand recall and expand the network's appeal across diverse demographics and geographies, further reinforcing position in the evolving radio and entertainment landscape while creating long-term value for listeners, advertisers and stakeholders.

The acquisition of strategic stake in VTV News broadens media portfolio, strengthens presence across multiple communication platforms and enhances ability to offer integrated media solutions. This diversification will contribute positively to growth journey while reinforcing position as a multi-platform media enterprise.

Subsidiary Ved Technoserve India Pvt Ltd completed pilot project for Pathankot Airbase (BEL) for Electric Smart Power Fence; BEL has 22 other IAF sites which can be allotted through tender after successful acceptance; company also exploring opportunities at 150+ airports in India.

The M&E industry presents significant growth potential driven by accelerating urbanization, government initiatives like integrated vehicle tracking systems and Smart TV platforms, and the government's push to include radio functionality in mobile handsets. Radio stations are diversifying revenue streams through branded content, podcasts, and on-ground events. Digital audio advertising and programmatic advertising are growing. The company is strategically positioned to leverage these developments in its home state Gujarat, which remains a key growth hub.

The company foresees ample opportunities of unique techno-media projects because of tailwind due to infrastructural development for Common Wealth Games, Olympic, increased live concerts and events etc. The Company is ready to capture and seize such opportunities to accelerate growth.

Forward-looking statements are based on certain assumptions and expectations of future events. The Company cannot guarantee that these assumptions and expectations are accurate or will be realized. The Company's actual results, performance or achievements could thus differ materially from those projected in any such forward-looking statements.

The Group continues to monitor the finalisation of the central and state rules and any further clarifications issued by the Government under the new labour codes, and will record any changes in the period in which such update arise.
